gloss: part; site; region (of the body or an object)

definitions.gloss: part; site; region (of the body or an object)
definitions.explanation: A specific location or area, especially of the human body. Commonly used in medical, anatomical, and culinary (meat cuts) contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{部位|ぶい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me where it hurts.
examples.notes: Literally: Please tell me the part where there is pain.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{部位|ぶい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なくて→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ヘルシーだ。
examples.english: The meat from this cut is low in fat and healthy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}する→手術する：22641_shujutsusuru⟧{部位|ぶい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦マーカー→マーカー：21828_maakaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{印|しるし}→印：03254_shirushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The surgical site is marked before entering the operating room.

notes:
USAGE:
{部位|ぶい} is more specific and technical than ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (part, portion). While ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ can refer to any part of anything, {部位|ぶい} is most naturally used for body parts, anatomical regions, and cuts of meat.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{患部|かんぶ}→患部：18653_kanbu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部位|ぶい} (affected area)
- ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部位|ぶい} (cut of meat)
- {部位|ぶい}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (by body part/region)

DOMAIN:
Frequently used in medical contexts (⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧{部位|ぶい} — surgical site) and in butchery/cooking when discussing different cuts of meat.
